result.brief: 提出面向时间序列的动作条件世界模型，用变量级潜状态转移与观测校正实现干预效应预测与闭环规划，并揭示事实预测、干预保真与决策质量之间的排序不一致。
result.reason: Action-conditioned latent world model for time series with intervention-effect prediction and planning; world-modeling ideas transfer, but no video/multimodal or visual representation contribution.
